high_level_description: This image depicts the entrance to a building named "Anantha Sahara." The building is painted white with red accents around the windows and arches. The name "Anantha Sahara" is prominently displayed vertically on the wall in green and black letters, with "SAI SAHARA" written horizontally below it in red. The entrance features an arched doorway with a small overhang supported by columns. A metal gate is partially open, revealing a red scooter parked inside. The ground in front of the building is paved with rectangular tiles, and there are steps leading up to the entrance.
